name: Phil Armour
role: Chicago meat packer and cattle buyer
bio: Phil Armour was a Chicago cattle buyer and meat packer; in February 1885 the paper reported one of the highest prices it had heard of, which he paid for steers, and in 1886 a Chicago commission man, speaking to Texas stockmen, called him virtually the only buyer on the Chicago market. In October 1886 the paper reported the end of the Chicago stockyards strike and the departure of the new men Armour had hired.

moments.label: Accused of controlling Chicago cattle prices
